title: Count Elements With Strictly Smaller and Greater Elements
summary: Given an integer array nums, count how many elements have both a strictly smaller and a strictly greater element present in nums.
statement: Given an integer array nums, count how many elements have both a strictly smaller and a strictly greater element present in nums.
constraints: nums is nonempty and may contain duplicates.
Count occurrences having some strictly smaller value and some strictly greater value elsewhere.
Return the number of qualifying occurrences.
hints: An element has both witnesses exactly when it is strictly between the global minimum and maximum.
Find the two extrema once, then count occurrences satisfying min<value<max.
Return sum(smallest<value<largest for value in nums).
A smaller and greater witness exist for every interior value, while either extreme necessarily lacks one side.
editorial: A smaller and greater witness exist for every interior value, while either extreme necessarily lacks one side.

tests.explanation: Seven and eleven lie strictly between the minimum two and maximum fifteen.
Both occurrences of three qualify, so the answer is two.
